sara_sales: Quick heads up — Greenline POC kickoff. They want: streaming SDK integration, function/tool calling for lookup ops, and strictly structured JSON responses (validated against a schema). Also need answers for SSO (SAML) + on-prem connector + basic pricing for hosted vs dedicated. Can SE + eng help coordinate?

mike_se: On it. Do we have target QPS / concurrency and max sequence length for gen?

sara_sales: Customer expects ~200 QPS peak, bursty during business hours. Typical prompt ~400 tokens, responses up to 800 tokens. Latency target <300ms p50 if hosted, <150ms p50 if on dedicated GPU.

raj_engineer: Re: integration — recommend using our websocket streaming SDK for low tail latency + function calling for authoritative lookups. Example for node: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, streaming: true });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw-large-quant', schema: customerSchema, functions: [ { name: 'get_account', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['id'] } } ] });
stream.on('data', (chunk) => { // chunk may be partial JSON, client buffers + validates against schema on complete } );
```
Use `schema` to enforce structured output; SDK will return a schema-validation error if model output doesn't match. For function calls, set `functions: { invokeOnMismatch: true }` if you want automatic fallback.

mike_se: A couple of engineering notes: 
- Set `batch_size: 8` and `kv_cache: true` for prefix-heavy flows.
- For streaming with structured output, we recommend `max_output_tokens` capped to avoid runaway cost.
- If you need deterministic JSON, enable `responseMode: 'json_strict'` so we post-process fewer corrections.

natalie_presales: Security checklist items Greenline flagged: SAML IdP, data residency (EU-only), KMS integration, and an offline on-prem agent option. We can cover SAML + KMS in Hosted with Private VPC. On-prem package has a 6-week lead time for enterprise install + compliance review.

sara_sales: Pricing question from them: roughly compare a hosted bill vs monthly reserved Dedicated for that QPS (200).

mike_se: Very rough: hosted (pay-as-you-go) expected to be lower initially — approx $X-$Y / month for their traffic depending on model variant and actual token count. Dedicated reserved: baseline ~ $30k-$45k/month for a small GPU pool sized for <500 QPS with committed throughput, plus lower per-token compute. If they need EU-only capacity in Dedicated, add regional infra premium (~+10-15%). Exact quote needs their 30-day token histogram.

raj_engineer: For the POC we can do a 2-week hosted sandbox (fastest) then migrate to Dedicated for performance test. Quick POC runbook: 
1) Provide sample prompt set + expected JSON schema (they should supply).
2) We ship a sample Node + Python demo that uses streaming + function calling (can wire to their lookup API).
3) Run load test with our replay tool (we can run on their data shape) and confirm latency SLOs.
4) If all good, propose Dedicated sizing and a 30-day trial run.

sara_sales: Can someone prep the demo repo and a short runbook for them by EOD tomorrow? Also flag the security questionnaire items we can answer now.

mike_se: I'll drop a minimal demo repo link + load test script by EOD. Will include `docker-compose` to run a local mock for function endpoints.

natalie_presales: I'll start the security Q answers. For SAML, tell them we support IdP metadata import and SCIM provisioning; for KMS we support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS/HSM). I'll attach the partial answers in the GH tracker.

ci-bot: deploy status: presales/demo-starter repo CI passed (build #442). Link: https://ci.internal/repo/442

sara_sales: Great — let's collate next steps: Mike = demo + load test, Raj = sample SDK snippets + schema validator notes, Natalie = security Q answers + on-prem timeline. I'll sync with Greenline for token histograms and sample schema. Thanks team :thumbsup:
